About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced AWS Connect Engineer to architect, build, and scale our next-generation cloud contact center infrastructure within our Global Capability Center (GCC). Bridging traditional enterprise telephony and modern serverless/AI-driven cloud architecture, you will lead legacy-to-cloud migrations, engineer resilient omnichannel contact flows, and deploy agentic AI workflows that elevate both customer self-service and live agent productivity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Omnichannel & Flow Engineering: Design, build, and maintain modular Amazon Connect (Connect Customer) contact flows, routing profiles, queues, and digital messaging channels (Voice, Chat, Email, WhatsApp Business).
  • Agentic AI & Conversational Self-Service: Configure and tune customer-facing AI Agents, Agent Assist (formerly Amazon Q in Connect), Amazon Lex bots, and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Implement Contact Lens for real-time sentiment analysis, automated quality evaluations, and PII redaction.
  • Serverless & Backend Integrations: Develop low-latency AWS Lambda functions (Node.js/Python) and API Gateway integrations to execute dynamic data dips, customer lookups, and backend transactions.
  • Enterprise Telephony & Migration: Lead phased migrations from legacy platforms (Cisco, Avaya, Genesys) to Amazon Connect. Manage SIP trunking via Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector, DID/toll-free porting, WebRTC optimization, and Amazon Connect Global Resiliency across AWS regions.
  • CRM & Agent Workspace: Integrate Amazon Connect with enterprise CRMs (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, Zendesk, ServiceNow) using the Amazon Connect Streams API, Customer Profiles, and Cases to deliver unified screen pops and automated after-call summaries.
  • Data Pipelines & Observability: Build and maintain contact center telemetry pipelines streaming Contact Trace Records (CTRs) and Contact Lens outputs via Amazon Kinesis to S3, Athena, and QuickSight for operational BI. Monitor platform health via CloudWatch and EventBridge.
  • DevOps, Testing & Security: Provision infrastructure as code using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation/CDK. Automate flow validation using Amazon Connect native testing and simulation in CI/CD pipelines, enforcing strict IAM least-privilege, encryption, and GDPR/PCI-DSS compliance.

Requirements

  • Telephony Background: 3+ years of experience engineering enterprise contact centers (Cisco, Genesys, Avaya, or similar) and understanding core telecom concepts (SIP, WebRTC, QoS).
  • Development Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js or Python. Strong grasp of building and interacting with REST APIs.
  • Language: Professional working proficiency in English (B2/C1 minimum) with clear verbal communication.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • AWS Connect Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience deploying and managing Amazon Connect in a production environment.
  • AWS Ecosystem: Deep familiarity with AWS services that support Connect, specifically Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and API Gateway.


Why work for us? 

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development. We offer competitive salaries, bonus incentives, benefits, flexible hours, and mentoring. Apply now to become part of the team. 

AllCloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.
